quote_coverage: Historical research convention: isolated source gaps are carried forward for no more than 5 business days. This is not the strict observed-quote certification used by the formal out-of-sample evaluator. See observed_quote_coverage.csv.
interpretation: Current fixed rules replay earlier holdings before the evaluation interval; historical windows inspected during research are not untouched holdout evidence.
benchmark_convention: All series are SGD total-return proxies net of 0.05% executed-notional fees. VT/STI are buy-and-hold, entered at the next close after the first replay signal, with no forced final liquidation.
trade_definition: FIFO units reconcile to post-fee NAV and closing weights. Recorded fees are allocated, not estimated twice. Win rate, holding period and profit per trade exclude fee-funding-only sales and open lots. Opening holdings are marked at the evaluation boundary. No ordinary closed trades means unavailable, not zero win rate.
sora_convention: Latest prior-value-date SORA published by return date; annual percent / 100 * actual calendar gap / 365. Publication availability improves holiday alignment relative to research shift/reindex.
realistic_cost_convention: Supplementary frozen-weight/trade-path sensitivity, not a reoptimized or independently executed portfolio. Initial scenario NAV equals requested capital; inherited positions are not charged again. Market/currency fees and annual tax proxies follow explore; VT annual tax proxy is 0.36%. FX charged per foreign trade without currency netting. Impact = min(1%, 0.10 * lagged 20-session daily volatility * sqrt(order SGD / lagged 20-session median SGD volume)), minimum 5 observations. Order value uses pre-cost post-return NAV. No empirical broker calibration. No realistic FIFO metrics.
historical_quote_warning: Observed quote coverage is incomplete; forward-filled prices cannot establish completion. Refresh market data.
